_comment: @primer/octicons (installed) provides SVG alternatives for concept icons: database-16.svg (SQL/MySQL), mortar-board-16.svg (Teaching), code-16.svg (generic code), paintbrush-16.svg (CSS/design), terminal-16.svg (CLI).
